== Summary ==
[[Dan Burns]] at his Decipher workstation, 1996. The printed caption reads: "Dan sets up the cards Quark files (above) for final printing, and Joe (right) models the press sheets." Photo: InQuest.

== Source ==
* Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60; photograph on p. 60. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n61/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n61). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Cropped from the top photograph on the page scan to the man at the computer only (733×405).
* Identification: the caption names only "Dan"; the article's only Dan is Dan Burns, and Bill identified him under the Small World Rule (only so many Decipher staff named Dan). See [[Talk:Dan Burns]].

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a magazine article about how Decipher made ''Star Wars'' CCG cards, used only to identify Dan Burns on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.
